phases.name: OBSERVE
phases.rule: re-fetch current state before acting; never act on stale data

phases.name: SIGN_IN
phases.rule: state not events; Team Naya coordination uses Issue #554

phases.name: ACT
phases.rule: do not report partial work as complete; never cross human gates

phases.name: SCORECARD
phases.rule: honest score; hard gates cannot be overridden

phases.name: LEARN
phases.rule: if evidence-backed learning would change a future decision, capture through canonical Smart Note path

phases.name: REPEAT
phases.rule: begin OBSERVE immediately; never idle; stopping is the failure mode

invariants.no_duplicate_lanes: claim scan before new work; on COLLISION coordinate or stand down
invariants.merge_protocol: no merge without valid five-step Scorecard Law receipt publicly posted on Issue #554
invariants.handoff: every consequential sign-out leaves durable evidence and exactly one successor action
invariants.board_truth_boundary: Issue #554 is coordination; canonical files and verified evidence establish truth
invariants.correction_duty: own errors publicly within one cycle; repair mechanism, verify, continue

failure_recovery.uncertain: READ_MORE when cheap evidence could materially change ranking; otherwise highest-value reversible authorized action
failure_recovery.blocked_human_gate: record blocker and owner; continue with next admissible action
failure_recovery.blocked_other_lane: coordinate on Issue #554; never silent workaround
failure_recovery.verification_failed: mark incomplete; diagnose, repair or re-rank
failure_recovery.error_made: own publicly within one cycle; repair mechanism; verify; continue
